purpose: Third follow-up register after continuing the Opus R01/R02/R03 cleanup. This appends closure evidence for control-LUT mutation, sim_binding schema/gate class, prompt figure ordering, and local artifact hygiene without rewriting prior registers.

items.closure_summary: Control LUT generation no longer silently writes models/control_lut.json through library calls; run() requires an explicit output_path, generated_at is injectable, and the CLI requires --output-path before writing any artifact.
All 12 r02 sim_binding files now carry simulation_status, model_maturity, and gate_class and are validated by models/sim_binding_schema.json plus coverage cross-check tests.
Coverage and sim_binding records now distinguish smoke and proxy gate classes, with tests preventing binding_smoke_passed records from being treated as proxy or production targets.
r03 prompt maturity tests now enforce figure heading order as 图 1, 图 2, 图 3, 图 4 for every production drawing prompt pack.
review-pr/ is now ignored and guarded by a repository hygiene test, reducing the risk that external HTML references are accidentally staged by broad add commands.

.claude/worktrees/, .claude/cache/, and .claude/sessions/ are now ignored and covered by a repository hygiene test. This closes the repository-hygiene side of the item; stale local branches still require manual owner cleanup outside this patch.
combined_losses now returns total_loss and iron_loss_fraction with tests documenting that the second value is not efficiency_percent.
EXP-011 now reports scan and target-torque frequency out-of-range counts/max values for the Bertotti coefficient freq_max_hz scope.
EXP-011 iron-loss ratios now use matching average numerator/denominator populations, with separate valid-frequency KPIs for non-extrapolated target points.
Flux LUTs now carry motor_id and pole_pairs in schema/sample data, and control LUT generation rejects pole-pair or motor-id mismatches before using nonlinear LUT data.

items.remaining_gap: codex-review-line and claude-mainline integration is still a branch-management task, not closed by local code/test changes in the dirty claude-mainline worktree.
items.next_action: Run the branch_integration_strategy.md migration/cherry-pick workflow from a clean integration branch.

items.next_action: Cherry-pick or reimplement the PyFluent workflow with dry-run and manifest tests before marking PyFluent items closed.

items.closure_summary: models/demag_limit_estimate.json is now part of the V2 binding deliverable set and S01/S02/S11 resolve their shared demag_limit $ref through the acceptance harness.

items.remaining_gap: The worktree is still dirty with multiple modified and untracked files. The new .gitignore prevents two high-risk local directories, but this does not close full worktree hygiene until an intentional integration/staging plan is executed.
items.next_action: Stage/commit the intended deliverable set explicitly and resolve or ignore remaining unrelated local artifacts.
